    Social

    Shareline promptFills Shareline 1–3

    Generate 3 promotional sharelines for the article below. Each shareline must be 11 words or fewer, compelling, and encourage readers to click through to the original article.

    Sent with the article's content each time you generate.

    Article Questions

    Question promptFills Question 1–5

    Suggest 5 positive questions based on the key subjects of this article, keep each question no more than twelve words, no introduction. Do not create questions like 'what do you think?', instead it is more a case of 'how would this work'. Make sure that you ask a variety of different questions so that no two are similar. The questions should be phrased in a way that an expert system could answer if it had the content available. Check and update the questions to make sure they meet the criteria.

    Sent with the article's content each time you generate.

    Summary

    Summary promptFills Summary

    Summarise the following article in two to three short paragraphs using a clear, journalistic tone. Begin with one sentence summarising the main point (“The big picture”). Then highlight the key facts, figures, and context that explain why it matters. Conclude with implications or next steps where relevant. Keep the summary under 200 words, concise, factual, and readable — like an Axios “Smart Brevity” piece. Avoid repetition, adjectives, or opinion; focus only on verified information.

    Sent with the article's content each time you generate.
